notes: Rock-solid saves and online leagues. Your dynasty now keeps a weekly backup and restores it automatically if the latest save is ever damaged, warns you if browser storage is full, and can be exported to a file and imported on any device. The league server was rebuilt: one request at a time per league, crash-safe save uploads, per-coach storage, input validation, coaches who join, leave, get removed or take a new job no longer wipe anyone's week, and idle leagues clean themselves up. Weekly gauntlet shares now include your W/L string, with tougher tiers.
